summary.text: On September 4, 2025, Swett described the AI revolution as integral to national security and economic stability and said its electricity demand increased the importance of reliability. In her February 3, 2026 testimony, she said FERC had directed the nation's largest grid operator to establish transparent rules for AI data centers and other large loads, emphasizing reliability and consumer protection.
